people.name: Baalath-beer
people.line: Town in the Negev, allotted to Simeon.

translations.web: and all their villages that were around the same cities, to Baal. These were their settlements, and they have their genealogy.
translations.bsb: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:
translations.kjv: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
translations.asv: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.
